title: Synthetic Control with Weight Uncertainty: Robust Identification and Statistical Inference
abstract: arXiv:2511.02632v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The synthetic control method estimates causal effects by comparing a treated unit with weighted controls matched on its pre-treatment trajectory. However, validity can be compromised when highly correlated controls leave the synthetic weights weakly determined or when treated-control relationships shift after treatment. We propose a new estimand, the weight-robust treatment effect, defined as the optimizer of a worst-case optimization problem over an uncertainty class of synthetic weights compatible with the pre-treatment fit. We establish its connection to sensitivity analysis: the uncertainty class induces an interval of plausible treatment effects, and the proposed estimand is the point in the interval closest to zero. Under the classical identification conditions, the estimand coincides with the true treatment effect. translated_title: 合成控制法中的权重不确定性：稳健识别与统计推断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2511.02632v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：合成控制法通过将处理单元与其预处理轨迹匹配的加权对照组进行比较来估计因果效应。然而，当高度相关的对照组使合成权重确定不充分，或处理与对照关系在处理后发生改变时，有效性可能受损。我们提出一种新的估计目标——权重稳健处理效应，定义为在预处理拟合兼容的合成权重不确定性类上的最坏情况优化问题的解。我们建立了其与敏感性分析的联系：不确定性类产生一个合理的处理效应区间，所提出的估计目标是该区间中最接近零的点。在经典识别条件下，该估计目标与实际处理效应一致。当这些条件不满足时，该估计目标仍可点识别；若不确定性类包含真值，则其保持稳健。
tldr: 本文提出一种权重稳健处理效应估计量，通过最坏情况优化处理合成权重不确定性和处理-对照关系变化，在经典条件下与真效应一致，否则仍可点识别，并建立敏感性区间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a weight-robust treatment effect estimator via worst-case optimization over synthetic weight uncertainty, matching the true effect under classical conditions and remaining point-identified otherwise, with a sensitivity interval.
